limitations: Visual review and subjective audition are separate checks.
Cue boundary and waveform checks verify delivered speech coverage relative to the approved PCM. They do not independently prove every synthesized word was pronounced correctly.
Preserved-region declarations are checked from the narration manifest; lexical ASR diagnostics remain separate.
Illustrated learning examples do not establish measured learning effectiveness.
